_about: Low spender (F-14 Budget Reality Check, profile `low`, $5–100/month per research/perfis.md). Every number has an `evidence` substring that scripts/build-data.ts checks word for word in its card. Prices are USD list prices quoted by guides, sellers or players (2022–2026); stores in other currencies differ (EUR stores show the same digits in euros, A12-0602/A12-0607). Value per dollar follows the A12-0618 method: raw gems and VIP points per USD only; items are never priced in gems here.

profileRangeUsdPerMonth.note: Project convention (research/perfis.md), not a game value.

priceWarning: Prices are list prices quoted by guides, sellers and players between 2022 and 2026, in USD. Your store's price depends on region, currency, taxes and date; check it in-game before you plan with it.

purchases.label: Growth Fund (one-time)
purchases.items: Gems paid at City Hall milestones; the City Hall 25 milestone alone pays 40,000 gems (player reports).

evidence.A12-0607: US$14.99 in a 2025 player post and 17.99 EUR

purchases.note: Full value needs City Hall 24–25 (A12-0001). Whether a late purchase still pays milestones already passed is disputed (A12-0606).

purchases.label: 30-day Gem Supply (Supply Depot)
purchases.items: 650 gems a day for 30 days; players also report about 2,200 gems on purchase (not counted here).

evidence.A12-0601: pays 650 gems per day for 30 days (19,500)

purchases.note: 19,500 is the floor (daily part only). One seller says unclaimed days are lost (A12-0603), so claim every day.

purchases.label: 30-day Gem Supply at 50% off (one-time coupon)
purchases.items: Same supply as above, once, with a half-price coupon players report around City Hall 7.

evidence.A12-0602: ($4.99 / 4.99 EUR in player posts; ~$5 in guides
evidence.A12-0601: pays 650 gems per day for 30 days (19,500)

purchases.note: One player at City Hall 7 did not see the coupon (A12-0602).

purchases.label: Lucerne Scrolls, paid track ($5 tier)
purchases.items: About 145 h of speedups plus items (seller snapshot). The full unlock with the legendary pattern needs the $20 bundle.

evidence.A12-0609: LootBar lists the $5 tier as ~3,300 gems, 145 h speedups and 5,500 VIP

purchases.note: How often Lucerne Scrolls runs is not known (L-A12-07); one player pays it 'a month'.

purchases.label: Writer of History pop-up (each new legendary commander)
purchases.items: 10 sculptures of the new legendary commander (plus EXP and stars).

evidence.A12-0613: and costs $5; LootBar lists 1,050 gems, 600,000 EXP, 10 legendary stars, 525 VIP and 10 legendary sculptures

purchases.note: Appears only when you acquire a new legendary commander; the seller's own multi-pack lines imply 1,100 gems and 500 VIP (A12-0613).

purchases.label: 7-day Material Supply
purchases.items: Two legendary materials per pack (riseofkingdomsguides); a seller lists other contents.

gemEvidence.A12-0612: described as 1,000 gems plus two legendary materials

purchases.note: Sources disagree on gems per pack (1,000 vs ~1,050 vs ~700, A12-0612).

purchases.label: Super-value bundle, $5 tier (e.g. Call of the Ancients)
purchases.items: Bundle-specific items. Call of the Ancients resets every Sunday.

resetEvidence.A12-0608: Call of the Ancients resets every Sunday

purchases.note: Higher tiers of the same ladder give fewer VIP points per dollar (105 VIP/$ at $5, 60 at $100; A12-0608).

purchases.label: VIP Special Privileges packs, VIP 0–6 (one-time each)
purchases.items: Minamoto no Yoshitsune sculptures (170 across VIP 0–6) and other items; each pack is bought once.
purchases.note: Sum of the per-level prices (derived). The wiki table predates the 1.0.87 VIP bundle update (A05-0600).

purchases.label: Daily Special Offers, all three every day
purchases.items: Sculptures of a commander you choose, keys and speedups. From about kingdom day 43 (official note, scope unclear).

evidence.A12-0611: LootBar lists 30 days as $90 for ~36,000 gems and 21,750 VIP

purchases.note: About $3 a day per players; at ~$90 a month it uses almost the whole Low range, so it is shown as the ceiling, not a recommendation.

tiers.label: Pass-only (about $10–25 a month)

evidence.A12-0615: Growth Fund first (one-time), then the 30-day Gem Supply, then Lucerne Scrolls

tiers.note: Community order: Growth Fund, then the 30-day supply, then Lucerne Scrolls (A12-0615). Lucerne counted once a month is an assumption: its cadence is unknown.

tiers.label: Low, fuller budget (up to about $100 a month)
tiers.note: Adds pop-ups and weekly packs after the pass-only core. Writer of History once a month is an assumption: it appears only when you get a new legendary commander. Daily Special Offers (~$90/month) are listed separately as the ceiling.

recharge.text: Renew passes inside a recharge event: players report the gem supply, material supply and daily offers count toward recharge thresholds (the Growth Fund reportedly does not); the common daily recharge event asks for 2,500 purchased gems a day.

valueMethod.text: Value per dollar = raw gems ÷ price and VIP points ÷ price only. Pricing speedups, sculptures or materials in gems changes rankings by up to about 5× depending on the basis, and the store's '% value' labels use undiscounted prices.

evidence.A12-0618: Only raw gems (and VIP points) per USD can be computed defensibly from the cards
